This is the ATRAC3/ATRAC3+ decoder from FFmpeg, extracted into a
standalone library by PPSSPP. psprism imports the isolated decoder from
PPSSPP's ext/at3_standalone directory and removes its dependencies on
PPSSPP logging and allocation helpers.

The decoder sources retain their original copyright notices and are
licensed under GNU LGPL 2.1 or later. See COPYING.LGPLv2.1.
